name: math-source-preview
description: Render equations in the native LaTeX editor and reveal source at the cursor.

commands.title: Math Source Preview: Toggle In-Source Rendering

mathSourcePreview.enabled.description: Render inactive equations directly in the source editor.

mathSourcePreview.macros.description: MathJax macros used for source rendering.

mathSourcePreview.scale.description: Math font size relative to the editor font size. Equations shrink further when needed to fit existing source rows.

mathSourcePreview.activePreview.description: Show a rendered preview beside the equation being edited, while keeping its source visible.
